description: Place of occupation on the hills south of South Cadbury. Activity appears to run from the early Bronze Age, to beyond the 4th CE. During the 2nd BCE - 50 CE phase there appears to be a rectangular structure, immediately to the east of which human and animal burials, pottery, and metal work, were found deposited in an enclosure ditch. Subsequently this structure was interpreted as a shrine.
